Part 2 · the safeguards column

Safeguards are linked entries, not free text

  • One master list: each safeguard is written once.
  • A row links to entries; editing asks Global or Local.
  • Each entry carries a tag, a type and a PFD for LOPA.

      Interactive · the three rail groups of the Full edition

      Study, Analysis, Results

      The worksheet becomes HAZOP and LOPA in one table once LOPA columns are shown.

      Part 3 · symbols used in the LOPA scenario dialog

      Six quantities of a LOPA scenario

      $f_{IE}$initiating-event frequency: how often the cause happensper year $P_{E}$enabling condition: the plant state that must also be present– $P_{CM}$conditional modifier: ignition, a person present– $PFD_i$probability that IPL $i$ fails on demand– $f_{mit}$frequency of the consequence with every IPL countedper year $TEL$tolerable event likelihood for the severity $S$per year

      Library values in PHA Studio are teaching defaults in the CCPS style; replace them with your own data.

      Part 3 · derivation step 1 of 2

      From the cause to the mitigated frequency

      A High row asks whether the layers are enough. LOPA answers with a frequency.

      $f_{IE}=\sum_j f_{IE,j}$several causes add: any one starts the scenario
      $f_{unmit}=f_{IE}\,\prod P_{E}\,\prod P_{CM}$each condition must also hold: probabilities multiply
      $f_{mit}=f_{unmit}\,\prod_i PFD_i$every IPL must fail too: independent, so multiply

      Valid only if the IPLs are independent of the cause and of each other; otherwise drop the credit.

      Part 3 · derivation step 2 of 2

      How far from tolerable?

      $f_{mit}=f_{IE}\,\prod P_{E}\,\prod P_{CM}\,\prod_i PFD_i$
      $f_{mit}\le TEL \Rightarrow$ meetsthe layers already reach the target: nothing to add
      $RRF=f_{mit}/TEL$risk reduction factor still missing, above 1 is a gap
      $RRR=TEL/f_{mit}=1/RRF$the PFD one extra IPL must reach

      PHA Studio writes RRR and RRF as "None" when $f_{mit}\le TEL$.

      Part 3 · check the program on a published example

      The PHAWorks example, by hand

      $f_{mit}=f_{IE}\,\prod P_{E}\,\prod P_{CM}\,\prod_i PFD_i,\quad RRF=f_{mit}/TEL$
      $f_{mit}=10^{-2}\times5\times0.5\times0.5\times1\times10^{-2}\times10^{-1}=1.25\times10^{-5}$initiating event, two enabling, two modifiers, two IPLs
      $RRF=\dfrac{1.25\times10^{-5}}{10^{-6}}=12.5,\quad RRR=0.08$TEL $10^{-6}$ per year for this severity

        Part 3 · summary

        What part 3 settled

        • Full turns the worksheet into HAZOP and LOPA in one table.
        • $f_{mit}$ multiplies the cause frequency by conditions and IPL failures.
        • RRF above 1 is a gap; RRR is the PFD one more IPL must reach.
        • Hand in the study file after the data check and the report.

        This deck

        Key Takeaways

        1

        Read the node intent first, then ask every meaningful guide word × parameter pair.

        2

        Judge severity without safeguards and likelihood with them; link safeguards, never retype them.

        3

        Load the worked node N1 from the File menu and copy its pattern, not its rows.

        4

        Send every High row to LOPA: an RRF above 1 means one more layer is needed.
